verdicts.reason: A shifts the whole layout down about 15px and leaves the photo panel flush to the right edge but with dark strips above and below it. That framing looks accidental, and the panel no longer bleeds off the edges as it did in the original. B insets the photo panel by about the same amount on the top, right and bottom, so the frame looks deliberate, and its left column spreads out a little more evenly. B still loses the full-bleed photo and leaves a slightly heavy gap below the CTA. In both, the SAVE 15% badge still floats unanchored between the logo and the headline.
